title: Account Bundler & Quick-Sizing Playbook for Dedicated/Private Feature Requests
creator: Nina Patel
description: Create a repeatable 'Account Bundler' playbook that lets AE/CS collect, cluster, and produce a one-page initial sizing for enterprise feature requests related to Dedicated/Private deployments (non-bug asks). The playbook should produce: (1) a prioritized bundle of related asks across accounts, (2) a 1-2 sprint rough engineering sizing, (3) a recommended commercial posture (pilot / add-on / roadmap), and (4) handoff checklist for Solutions/SEs. Goal: reduce first-response time from sales/cs by 60% and make portfolio-level decisions faster.
business_impact: Reduces manual triage time for Sales/CS, surfaces near-term bundleable customer needs, improves win-rate for Dedicated contracts by enabling faster pilot proposals. Expected to accelerate sales cycle for >$250k ARR opportunities and reduce engineering context-switching by grouping similar asks.
customer_examples: Large FS customer requesting per-tenant billing and audit exports for Private deployment (Account: NorthStar Capital)
Health-tech customer asking for on-prem key management integration and automated upgrades (Account: WellBridge)
Marketplace platform asking for model pinning + regional routing controls across dedicated pools (Account: MarketFlow)
triage_notes: Initial sweep of inbound feature requests (Jan 2026) found 42 enterprise asks that overlap across 9 accounts — common themes: billing/audit, KMS integrations, deployment orchestration, and model pinning.
High-signal asks tend to cluster by product area (Private infra, Dedicated autoscale, Console rollouts) rather than by account vertical.
Sales reps frequently attach customer slides and procurement timelines — include a mandatory 'customer impact & timing' field in form.
initial_scope_estimate: Baseline bundler MVP: 5 engineer-weeks (2 backend, 1 infra, 1 PM/design touch, 1 SE docs). Deliverables: bundler template, intake form updates, triage rubric, example bundle for 3 accounts.
acceptance_criteria: AE/CS can produce a completed bundle document using the playbook inside 48 hours of the last customer ask added.
Bundle template includes: grouped asks, estimated engineering range (t-shirt S/M/L), recommended commercial stance, list of affected accounts, and next-steps owner.
Pilot bundle used in at least two sales opportunities and documented outcomes (win/lose/rejected) in three weeks.
Hand-off checklist accepted by Solutions/SE and Engineering on first trial run.
decisions: Scope MVP to Dedicated/Private feature requests only (exclude hosted API ask types for now).
Use existing Intake Google Form with two added fields ("Customer Timing" and "Business Priority") rather than building new tooling for MVP.
Prioritization rubric will weight: revenue potential, cross-account frequency, implementation complexity, and strategic account importance.
next_steps: Create bundled template doc and example bundle for NorthStar Capital + WellBridge + MarketFlow (owner: Marco). Due 2026-02-05.
Partner with Solutions Engineering to run one 'bundle trial' during Q1 AE calls (owner: Priya Rao).
Implement two extra fields in intake form and update Sales playbook (owner: Growth Ops).
Schedule review with Eng infra and Runtime leads to validate sizing assumptions (owner: Nina).
